name: At the Bottom
detailed_description:
Only when you hit rock bottom can you truly see the light.

Will you dare to take the plunge?

Feel the collapse of your country.

The world’s cracking at the seams. Some still cling to yesterday, others already crawling in the dirt of a new reality. Life’s grinding wheel crushes the weak and spits them out—but if you’re ruthless enough, you might slip through.

You’re a nobody. Just a beggar in an underground tunnel.

But poverty’s got rules of its own.

Day by day, you learn to survive—reading people, finding their weak spots, twisting them to your advantage. Step by step, you build your crew from the same outcasts. A new kind of family. A street family.

The world didn’t ask who you want to be. It decided for you.

But can you claw your way to the top?

 Your tools of survival:

  • Beg

    Sniff out what breaks people—guilt, fear, or shame—and squeeze them for every coin they’ve got.

  • Recruit misfits

    That legless war vet? Useless to most. The shady street musician? Weird vibes. The blind fortune teller? Creepy but convincing. All of them could be gold.

  • Run shady deals

    What brings in more cash — offering desperate souls a date with the porcelain throne or peddling some shady pies?

  • Steal what’s yours

    The rich won’t miss it. You deserve it. Fair's fair, right?

  •  Grow your gang

    More beggars, more turf, more power. Become the legend whispered through alleyways.

  • Pay off the cops

    You can’t bribe fate, but you can bribe the cops. Decide your approach: feed their greed, or find another way to shake off the heat.

  •  Crush your rivals

    Make an example out of them. Show everyone who runs this concrete jungle.

  •  Survive the dark

    No mercy, no rules, no backup.

Sink to the bottom—and maybe, just maybe, rise above it all.
